summary: Sample graph publication is hold with 3 critical, 6 high, and 2 warning finding(s).

findings.message: SAMPLE-BETA has 1 temperature excursion(s) outside policy.
findings.impact: Temperature excursions can invalidate assay/sample relationships.
findings.remediation: Hold graph edges until excursion review and assay impact notes are attached.

findings.message: SAMPLE-BETA custody chain breaks between events 0 and 1.
findings.impact: Unexplained custody gaps undermine sample identity and provenance.
findings.remediation: Insert the missing transfer or hold graph publication for the sample.

findings.impact: Graph edges should not trust sample identity without custody evidence.
findings.remediation: Attach signed handoff events from collection through analysis.

findings.impact: Long delays can degrade molecular measurements and mislead graph recommendations.
findings.remediation: Hold sample edges until degradation impact is reviewed or replacement evidence is supplied.

findings.message: SAMPLE-BETA has an incomplete custody handoff at event 1.
findings.impact: Each transfer should identify source, recipient, timestamp, and signature.
findings.remediation: Complete the signed custody handoff record.

findings.message: SAMPLE-BETA exceeds the allowed freeze-thaw cycle limit.
findings.impact: Repeated thawing can degrade sample analytes and invalidate reuse recommendations.
findings.remediation: Suppress reuse/recommendation edges or attach validated degradation analysis.

findings.message: SAMPLE-GAMMA is missing preservation protocol evidence.
findings.impact: Samples should not create trusted graph edges without preservation records.
findings.remediation: Attach preservation protocol id and timestamp.

findings.message: SAMPLE-BETA has integrity score 0.69, below policy threshold.
findings.impact: Low-integrity samples should not be recommended as high-confidence evidence.
findings.remediation: Downgrade or hold sample graph edges until a curator reviews quality evidence.

findings.message: SAMPLE-GAMMA has no cold-chain temperature log.
findings.impact: Cold-chain evidence protects downstream graph conclusions from degraded samples.
findings.remediation: Attach temperature logger evidence before publishing sample edges.

findings.message: SAMPLE-BETA is missing required graph edge type(s): sample-to-assay.
findings.impact: Entity pages need complete sample-to-protocol/dataset/evidence linkage.
findings.remediation: Attach the missing edge evidence or mark the sample as partial provenance.

findings.message: SAMPLE-GAMMA is missing required graph edge type(s): sample-to-dataset, sample-to-assay.
findings.impact: Entity pages need complete sample-to-protocol/dataset/evidence linkage.
findings.remediation: Attach the missing edge evidence or mark the sample as partial provenance.
